open_items: dynamic_range_min: null (guide has no peak; no shipped reference image).
The guide rms is a CARTA region statistic on the residual; the verifier uses off-source residual rms outside 5 beams of the peak and outside nonzero model pixels. Agreement not measured until build.
Self-calibration improvement (6.6 to 2.0 mJy) is not gradeable: no selfcal stage or before/after observable exists.
